features.description: MongoDB connection + Mongoose models (Admin, Region, Location, Service, SiteSettings) with indexes
features.notes: Implemented all 5 Mongoose models (Admin, Region, Location, Service, SiteSettings) with proper schemas, timestamps, unique slug constraints, and indexes. Database connection module supports in-memory MongoDB for tests via mongodb-memory-server, fails fast with clear error if MONGODB_URI missing in non-test environments. SiteSettings uses unique 'key' field (default 'main') for singleton enforcement. 24 model tests pass: validation, duplicate slugs (with Model.init()), price constraints, gallery metadata, visibility flags, SiteSettings singleton/upsert. Typecheck passes. Tests use isolated in-memory DB without requiring real MongoDB credentials.
